claim: VALIDATION: the agentic LLM router's E045 prediction was CORRECT. composite-router on spooky-author-identification returned the text-classification family default (sonnet-all) and produced INVALID submission at $7.84 — failure: 'Each row in submission should sum to one, as probabilities'. The agent had predicted opus-all is needed (E045) — this run confirms sonnet-all fails on spooky-author. Failure mode is slightly different from detecting's schema gate (E020); here it's a probability normalization issue. Multiple nodes hit transformers env import errors (DebertaV2 imports failing in the spooky-author conda env), which contributed but is not the only issue — the final aggregated submission was written but failed grader format check.

result.grader_error: Each row in submission should sum to one, as probabilities.

support.node_failures: Multiple nodes hit transformers env DebertaV2 import errors (env-level, not model-tied)
support.predicted_outcome_at_opus_all: valid submission OR substantially better — but unconfirmed (would cost ~$50-100 to run)

design_finding: On spooky-author, the family default sonnet-all is INSUFFICIENT — confirms the agent's E045 prediction was correct. The text-classification family memory needs updating: sonnet-all default applies to detecting (which has its own override to opus-all now) but does NOT generalize to spooky-author. The family memory should either (a) be promoted to opus-all by default (with text-classification's known_overrides reverted to whatever else works), OR (b) the family default rationale should explicitly note 'sonnet-all unproven on spooky/jigsaw; LLM-with-data should fire for new text-classification tasks.'
scope: Single cli.py validation of the family default. Confirms the agentic router's E045 prediction.
limitations: Did not run opus-all on spooky-author to confirm it produces valid sub.
Failure includes env-level transformers issues (not model-tied) — possible the sonnet-all routing could have succeeded with a different env.
confidence: high (the family default is broken on this task; agent prediction validated)
